title: Billing Operations Rule: Service Fee Return with Residential Electricity Supply Rebill Credits
content:
Billing operations rule, Residential Electricity Supply off-peak rebills.

**Rule.** The over-billed amount of the corrected line decides how much of the plan's monthly service fee is returned with the rebill credit. When it is 100 USD or more the full monthly service fee is added; when it is from 50 up to but not including 100 USD, half (a share of 0.5) of that fee is added; below 50 USD nothing is added.

**Inputs.** The over-billed amount is the corrected line's billed amount less its correct amount, before any multiplier. The fee is the monthly service fee of the plan in force on the agreement, as the plan pricing schedule states it.

| Over-billed amount of the corrected line | Added to the rebill credit |
|---|---|
| 100 USD or more | the plan's full monthly service fee |
| 50 USD up to but not including 100 USD | half of that fee |
| below 50 USD | nothing |

**Boundaries (hypothetical, monthly service fee of 9.95 USD).** An over-billed amount of 100.00 USD adds 9.95 USD; 99.99 USD adds 4.975 USD, carried unrounded into the total; 50.00 USD adds 4.975 USD; 49.99 USD adds nothing.
